review_focus: keep mythic Yokudan cosmology attributed to its source tradition
distinguish historical claims from legendary Sword-Singer accounts
preserve conflicting accounts of Yokuda's destruction
do not infer modern Redguard consensus from individual in-universe authors

quality_policy.cleanup_category: mark review_required rather than reject; UESP currently lists 115 Lore Places pages needing cleanup
quality_policy.unofficial_sources: retain only with explicit unofficial/lower-authority flag
